target.title: fix: diagnose Windows LAN Gateway firewall blocks
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users who bind the Gateway to LAN on Windows can see a healthy loopback probe and an advertised Control UI LAN URL even when Windows Firewall blocks other devices from reaching that URL.

Related context: materialized OpenClaw claim `ACTIONABLE-002-C3-inconclusive-windows-firewall-gateway-port`.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds a read-only Windows Firewall diagnostic for local LAN Gateway status and setup/configure output. The diagnostic inspects active Windows network profiles and matching inbound rules without mutating firewall policy, then surfaces actionable warnings for missing allow rules, local-rule policy, profile mismatch, scoped rules, and bounded inspection failures.

## User Impact

Windows users get a concrete firewall warning when OpenClaw advertises a LAN Control UI URL that loopback can reach but LAN clients may not. Users are guided to add an appropriate inbound TCP allow rule or use loopback, Tailscale, or SSH tunneling instead of LAN binding.

AI-assisted: implemented with Codex.

## Evidence

- `pnpm test src/infra/windows-gateway-firewall-diagnostics.test.ts src/commands/gateway-status.test.ts src/cli/daemon-cli/status.gather.test.ts src/cli/daemon-cli/status.print.test.ts src/wizard/setup.finalize.test.ts src/commands/configure.wizard.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose`
- `pnpm tsgo:core`
- `pnpm tsgo:test:src`
- `git diff --check`
- `node scripts/check-docs-mdx.mjs docs/web/control-ui.md`
- `$autoreview`: clean after addressing one accepted timeout-coupling finding.
- Live E2E on local Parallels Windows 11:
  - Pre-fix `HEAD^`: Gateway ready on loopback, advertised `http://10.211.55.3:28991/`, Mac LAN `curl /healthz` timed out, and `gateway status --deep --timeout 3000` showed no Windows Firewall warning.
  - Fixed `a00be9691a`: same LAN request still timed out, and `gateway status --deep --timeout 3000` emitted structured `gateway.windowsFirewall.code = "windows_firewall_program_scoped_rule_unverified"` with active profile `public` and actionable firewall guidance.
